title: Ice Cube

sources.title: Shaping of the Ice
markers: | summary = '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an action that allows a [[Way of the Four Elements]] monk to create an [[Ice Cube|ice cube]] that can be climbed.

summary: A 25 HP climbable ice block summoned by a Way of the Four Elements monk. Multiple blocks can be stacked.

fields.Creation: Use Shaping of the Ice as an Action and spend 1 Ki Point, range 60 ft. The roughly 3 ft cube lasts 10 turns. Recasting leaves earlier cubes in place.
fields.Moving the cube: Weighs about 441 lb and requires 17 Strength to shove or otherwise move. Normal Throw would require 32 Strength. Telekinesis can throw it.
fields.Defences: Vulnerable to Piercing, Thunder, Fire and Force. Resistant to Radiant. Immune to Necrotic, Cold, Psychic and Poison.
fields.Base value: 0 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
